description_en: Calls GetCurrentMode to query the current billing method
description_zh: 调用GetCurrentMode查询当前计费方式
name: GetCurrentMode

Code.description_en: The business code. A value of 0 indicates success

EffectiveAt.description_en: The effective period UNIX timestamp. This parameter is returned when an Upgrade/Downgrade has been submitted but has not yet taken effect
EffectiveAt.description_zh: 生效时间戳，当服务变配，且变配未生效时返回

EstimateBandwidth.description_en: The estimated monthly 95th percentile bandwidth (bit/s). This parameter is returned only when ModeCode is set to 95
EstimateBandwidth.description_zh: 预估月95带宽（bps），仅在ModeCode=95时返回

ModeCode.description_en:
The current billing method.

0: daily peak bandwidth.

1: daily traffic.

95: monthly 95th percentile bandwidth
ModeCode.description_zh:
当前计费方式。

0：日峰值带宽。

1：日流量。

95：月95峰值带宽

PaddingModeCode.description_en:
The billing method that is pending to take effect.

0: daily peak bandwidth.

1: daily traffic.

95: monthly 95th percentile bandwidth
PaddingModeCode.description_zh:
待生效计费方式。

0：日峰值带宽。

1：日流量。

95：月95峰值带宽
